text:
pat: quick note from support 123: onboarding README uses 'Token' prefix instead of 'Bearer' in curl example; customers get 401s.
ana: yikes. what does the snippet show?
pat: current README curl shows:
```
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```
lee: thats a simple copy/paste bug but wide impact. many CI systems will paste verbatim and fail auth.
support: we saw 3 tickets today where users pasted 'Token' and then assumed platform was down. they updated to 'Bearer' and it worked.
docs-bot: linter: Authorization header patterns show 'Token' instead of 'Bearer' in 1 docs file. Recommend PR to replace and add a short line about proper header formatting and a one-line curl variant for safe copy/paste.
pat: also a minor SDK parity callout: Node quickstart still shows an example using `client.generate()` while Python shows `client.text.generate()`. Newer SDKs unify on `client.text.generate(...)`. Users who copy different-language snippets see different shapes and get confused.
lee: fix plan: (1) update curl block to use Bearer and provide a single-line example for copy/paste, (2) add a short paragraph under quickstart: \"Headers must use Authorization: Bearer <token>\" and example for PowerShell, (3) normalize Node/Python snippets to match modern SDK surface, and add a compatibility note for older pinned SDKs.
support: please also add a short troubleshooting QA: \"If you see 401, check for leading/trailing spaces and correct prefix 'Bearer'.\" Customers love tiny checklists.
docs-bot: issue created #5321 \"quickstart: Authorization prefix + snippet parity\" and recommended PR template.
eng-service: FYI server performs exact prefix match; trimming might be considered but we prefer docs-first for now.
pat: i'll open a micro-PR with the curl fix and the one-line variant; will file the SDK parity issue for language leads to coordinate.
lee: thanks. small docs fixes but prevents a lot of friction.
support: confirmed one customer fixed their CI by switching to Bearer and removing an accidental trailing newline. closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
